description_target.target_text: This puzzle combines two legends. The first header row gives the target number of holes by using one extra blue(1) cell, so 1→0 holes, 2→1 hole, and 3→2 holes. The second header row chooses the symmetry class with the code 1 vertical-only, 2 horizontal-only, 3 both, 4 none. The body object matching both conditions is cropped and recolored to cyan(8).

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Two header rows spell a query: (count of 1s in row 0) - 1 = the
 ;; HOLE count, count of 2s in row 1 = the SYMMETRY class (1 -> 
 ;; left-right, 2 -> up-down, 3 -> both, else none). Scan the body
 ;; (rows 2+) in top-left order and answer with the first object
 ;; matching both, as its shape mask painted cyan(8).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (norm-cells obj)
       (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 obj))
                              (- (second p) (obj-c1 obj))))
            (obj-cells obj)))
     (define (mask-of obj color)
       (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0)
                    (norm-cells obj) color))
     (define (holes-of obj)  ;; enclosed 0-pockets of the shape mask
       (let ((mask (mask-of obj 1)))
         (length (filter (lambda (region)
                           (all? (lambda (p)
                                   (and (> (first p) 0)
                                        (< (first p) (- (rows mask) 1))
                                        (> (second p) 0)
                                        (< (second p)
                                           (- (cols mask) 1))))
                                 region))
                         (find-0-regions mask 0)))))
     (define (sym-class obj)  ;; up-down adds 1, left-right adds 2
       (let ((cells (norm-cells obj)))
         (+ (if (all? (lambda (p)
                        (member (list (- (obj-h obj) 1 (first p))
                                      (second p))
                                cells))
                      cells)
                1 0)
            (if (all? (lambda (p)
                        (member (list (first p)
                                      (- (obj-w obj) 1 (second p)))
                                cells))
                      cells)
                2 0))))
     (define holes-target
       (max (- (count-if (lambda (v) (= v 1)) (row g 0)) 1) 0))
     (define sym-target
       (let ((code (count-if (lambda (v) (= v 2)) (row g 1))))
         (cond ((= code 1) 2) ((= code 2) 1) ((= code 3) 3) (else 0))))
     (define target
       (find-first (lambda (o) (and (= (holes-of o) holes-target)
                                    (= (sym-class o) sym-target)))
                   (sort (objects (subgrid g 2 0 (- h 1) (- w 1)) 0)
                         (lambda (a b)
                           (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                               (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                               (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)))))))
     (mask-of target 8))))
